shortDescription: create, update, or destroy Automation Platform Controller inventory source.

options.name: controller_config_file
options.description: Path to the controller config file. If provided, the other locations for config files will not be considered.

options.name: controller_host
options.description: URL to your Automation Platform Controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_HOST) and then config files If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: controller_oauthtoken
options.description: The OAuth token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_OAUTH_TOKEN) and then config files

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD) and then config files

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME) and then config files

options.name: credential
options.description: Credential name, ID, or named URL to use for the source.

options.name: custom_virtualenv
options.description: Local absolute file path containing a custom Python virtualenv to use. Only compatible with older versions of AWX/Controller Deprecated, will be removed in the future

options.name: description
options.description: The description to use for the inventory source.

options.name: enabled_value
options.description: Value when the host is considered enabled, e.g., "powered_on"

options.name: enabled_var
options.description: The variable to use to determine enabled state e.g., "status.power_state"

options.name: execution_environment
options.description: Execution Environment name, ID, or named URL to use for the source.

options.name: host_filter
options.description: If specified, AWX will only import hosts that match this regular expression.

options.name: inventory
options.description: Inventory name, ID, or named URL the group should be made a member of.

options.name: limit
options.description: Enter host, group or pattern match

options.name: name
options.description: The name to use for the inventory source.

options.name: new_name
options.description: A new name for this assets (will rename the asset)

options.name: notification_templates_error
options.description: list of notifications to send on error

options.name: notification_templates_started
options.description: list of notifications to send on start

options.name: notification_templates_success
options.description: list of notifications to send on success

options.name: organization
options.description: Name of the inventory source's inventory's organization.

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Delete child groups and hosts not found in source.

options.name: overwrite_vars
options.description: Override vars in child groups and hosts with those from external source.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the controller host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: scm_branch
options.description: Inventory source SCM branch. Project must have branch override enabled.

options.name: source
options.description: The source to use for this group.

options.name: source_path
options.description: For an SCM based inventory source, the source path points to the file within the repo to use as an inventory.

options.name: source_project
options.description: Project name, ID, or named URL to use as source with scm option

options.name: source_vars
options.description: The variables or environment fields to apply to this source type.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in seconds) to run before the task is canceled.

options.name: update_cache_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds to consider an inventory sync to be current.

options.name: update_on_launch
options.description: Refresh inventory data from its source each time a job is run.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to AWX. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL) and then config files

options.name: verbosity
options.description: The verbosity level to run this inventory source under.
